article_content: Shayne Austin, a key witness in the Holly Bobo murder trial, was found dead. His lawyers confirmed that he had previously been offered immunity in exchange for his testimony against Zach Adams and Jason Autry. However, this offer was later rescinded. Austin's death occurred outside the state.
translated_content: Shayne Austin, en nyckel vittne i Holly Bobo-mordrätte, har hittats död. Hennes advokater bekräftade att han hade tidigare erbjudits immunitet i utbyte för sitt vittnesmål mot Zach Adams och Jason Autry. Men, detta erbjudande blev senare återtaget. Austins död tillkom utom staten.
